answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 7 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 94 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. What carries the yarrow here is verification, the dune of cost is what stops the farm, and the gale of the record keeps every claim checkable.
